select so.id, so.customer_id, so.customer_dept_id, so.code, so.source, so.type, so.amount, so.status, so.delivery_date, so.is_deleted, so.version, so.create_by, so.create_time, so.update_by, so.update_time, so.remark, coalesce(customer.alias, customer.name) as customerName, cd.name as customerDeptName, (select po.code from purchase_order po where po.order_date = so.delivery_date and po.status != 3 order by po.id desc limit 1) as purchaseOrderCode,
(select d.code from t_delivery_order d where d.is_deleted = 0 and (exists (select 1 from t_delivery_source_item si where si.delivery_id = d.id and si.sale_order_id = so.id) or exists (select 1 from t_delivery_order_detail dd where dd.delivery_id = d.id and dd.order_id = so.id)) order by d.id desc limit 1) as deliveryOrderCode, (select d.status = 3 from t_delivery_order d where d.is_deleted = 0 and (exists (select 1 from t_delivery_source_item si where si.delivery_id = d.id and si.sale_order_id = so.id) or exists (select 1 from t_delivery_order_detail dd where dd.delivery_id = d.id and dd.order_id = so.id)) order by d.id desc limit 1) as deliveryOrderVoided,
(exists (select 1 from t_delivery_source_item si2 join t_delivery_order d2 on d2.id = si2.delivery_id where si2.sale_order_id = so.id and si2.is_deleted = 0 and d2.is_deleted = 0 and d2.status != 3) or exists (select 1 from t_delivery_order_detail dd2 join t_delivery_order d3 on d3.id = dd2.delivery_id where dd2.order_id = so.id and d3.is_deleted = 0 and d3.status != 3) ) as allocated from t_sale_order so left join t_customer_dept cd on cd.id = so.customer_dept_id left join t_customer customer on customer.id = so.customer_id
